terraceFootprint.source: H01 p138; no independent corner chain

waistBearingFraming.note: Two tiers of transverse/longitudinal transfer beams connect the actual lower perimeter frame to principal continuations and waist short posts. The adopted short-post base is upper floor minus2.2m, independent of the measured stair landing; joint heights, beam sections and exact member positions are provisional.

waistPostLayout.note: Upper support spacing is proportionally mapped to the independently measured waist outer spans; individual short-post positions and centering remain unsurveyed implementation choices.

roofReferenceMapping.note: Cap crest uses H01 reference; tile meeting surface is lower by the shared generator cap rise. Low-detail generator omits chiwen, so ornament height and total historical bbox are not accepted.

galleryFloor.note: Flat simplification. Detail shows outward fall but outer elevation is unlabelled.

columnTops.note: Adopted joints below eave references, not measured clear column heights.

frontFlights.note: 32 steps each and approx2.3m center strip sourced; run/flight width adopted.

sideConnections.note: Approx0.9m drop and4.9m width sourced jointly; run/location/landing/guards adopted. Existing ground corridors are not survey-height verandas.

pavilion.visitorPolicy: Playable lower entry is a game choice, not museum access permission.
